email.body1:
Paul, Nowsta running flexible-workforce scheduling for the likes of Marriott puts you in front of a lot of enterprise employers at once.

That kind of reach usually means more in-market accounts than an enterprise team can personally cover before quota resets. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Nowsta off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Paul, quick follow-up for Nowsta.

In enterprise sales, the hard part is knowing how many qualified meetings the team needs to book to hit the number before the quarter is already decided. Most leaders spot the gap late, and by then recovering it is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Nowsta needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Paul, last bit of proof for Nowsta.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nowsta's reply rate likely compares to peer workforce-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Paul, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Nowsta either way.
